metadataRaw.title: Sciatica at Night? Do THIS Before Bed
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help relieve sciatica pain at night so you can sleep more comfortably.

If sciatica keeps you awake or gets worse when lying in bed, reducing tension and pressure on the sciatic nerve before sleep can make a big difference.

In this video, Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises designed to target common causes of nighttime sciatica pain. Best of all, they can be done right in bed—either before going to sleep or in the middle of the night when you need quick relief.

Each exercise works differently, so go through them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Give these exercises a try tonight and see if they help you sleep better with less sciatica pain.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:49 Warm-Up
2:04 Muscle Release
4:01 Muscle Release (Seated)
6:15 Press Up
8:20 Nerve Flossing
10:05 Nerve Flossing (Seated)
